title: Is Trump helping rehabilitate Putin on the world stage?
html:
Is Trump helping rehabilitate Putin on the world stage?

‘We really don’t know whether this is just going to be a glorified photo op.’ As Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping meet at the APEC summit, Al Jazeera’s James Bays examines whether the talks will deliver anything beyond symbolism.
summary: Is Trump helping rehabilitate Putin on the world stage?
